title: design: greet several names and pick a language
body:
## Request

`greet.sh` greets exactly one name, in English. We want it to greet several
names in one call and to greet in a language the caller picks.

Design this before anyone builds it: write the plan document, with tickets
small enough to hand to an unattended run.

## What we already know

- Several names means each positional argument gets its own line, in order.
- The language is picked with a `--lang <code>` flag. English stays the
  default. Start with English, Spanish and French; an unknown code is an
  error that names the codes it does know.
- `./test.sh` is the only check the repo has, and it has to keep passing.

## Out of scope

Config files, environment variables and translations beyond those three.
